items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that the pool hall, did you say you were in that route one time? Uh, the old Saint Sue. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah, I think they have a pool hall in there now.

ctx.x: I believe they have, uh, what's this boy's name? Around that, uh, place up there. It's a big nightclub he's got up there. Yeah. What is it there? That's near the Dutron. That's, that's the place. But I don't think it's the same building. No, it's just right in, it's in the same block. Yeah.
Is that the pool hall, did you say you were in that route one time? Uh, the old Saint Sue.
Yeah. Yeah, I think they have a pool hall in there now. Yeah, I think that's all connection to the one.
